setup-development-environment.description: Install the selected skills and configure the approved development workflow.

capture-intent.description: Preserve feature and architecture purpose in an existing brief or concise intent record.

write-commit-and-pr.description: Draft Git commit messages and PR descriptions explaining motivation, approach, and evidence.

finish-approved-work.description: Carry out an authorized merge, squash, publication, or owned-workspace cleanup with evidence and scope control.

execute-approved-work.description: Execute approved requirements with bounded workers, behavioral checks, and independent review.

setup-opencode-routing.description: Configure OpenCode role/model bindings, permissions, and reasoning defaults.

grill-with-docs.description: Clarify design decisions while retaining a glossary and architecture decisions.

domain-modeling.description: Maintain project terminology and record consequential design decisions.

tdd.description: Test observable behavior at agreed public boundaries, one red-green slice at a time.

codebase-design.description: Shared vocabulary for module boundaries and testing seams.

code-review.description: Independent standards and specification review of a defined change.

diagnosing-bugs.description: Investigate non-obvious bugs and performance regressions through a scoped reproduction or measurement loop.

writing-for-agents.description: Write and maintain concise skills and agent-facing instructions with clear triggers and completion criteria.

setup-matt-pocock-skills.description: Configure a project's tracker and domain-document conventions after approval.

to-spec.description: Turn agreed decisions into a specification using the configured tracker.

to-tickets.description: Decompose larger work into approved, dependency-aware vertical slices.
